run_GetQuickEvalStatsDirScript: run the ParlaiScript with --path to print validation statistics about API calls from a directory
run_get_align_apis: run get_align_apis to merge and print API call stats from eval_stats.json and processed stats files
run_get_apis_from_eval_stats: run get_apis_from_eval_stats to extract API call metrics from the eval_stats.json report dictionary
run_get_apis_from_processed_stats: run get_apis_from_processed_stats to parse mm_eval*pro*st* files and extract API call deltas
review_GetQuickEvalStatsDirScript: review the GetQuickEvalStatsDirScript class that compares API call validation stats between eval and processed data files
